The '''Event Organization Advocate''' is the eighth seat on the [[Players Committee]]'s Advocate Council, first listed on the Community Card of March 2026.<ref name="card2026">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Communitycard.html Community Card, Advocate Council tab], res.starwarsccg.org (file dated 18 March 2026)</ref> The current Event Organization Advocate is [[Karl Koenig]].

== Discrepancies ==
* '''Event Organization Advocate vs. Marketing Advocate:''' While the Advocate Council tab of the 18 March 2026 Community Card list designates [[Karl Koenig]] as Event Organization Advocate (and [[Jared Napolitano]] as [[Marketing Advocate]]),<ref name="card2026" /> Players Committee Slack announcements on 17 October 2025, 9 March 2026, and 2 April 2026—as well as Koenig's Series Three community card (''Karl K'')—identify Koenig as Marketing Advocate.<ref name="slack-eoa-mkt">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, "darkjediknight11", 17 October 2025 (“The Advocates are excited to announce our newest Marketing Advocate, none other than Karl Koenig!”); [[Dan Tartaglione]] (DTartagOne), 9 March 2026 (“Designer Andrew Moss and Marketing Advocate Karl Koenig join me for the first episode of 2026.”); and [[Karl Koenig]] (KrazyKarl), 2 April 2026 (“Also, there was a printing error with this years Donation event vouchers (bad new Marketing Advocate).”).</ref>
